messages.author: dba8d1ebc846c330
messages.subject: RE: [Rkoholiki] Multinomial mixed effects models
parts:
Here some packages which include multinominal mixed models:

-glmmADMB (http://www.mail-archive.com/r-l...@ling.ucsd.edu/msg00157.html)

-MCMCglmm (a bayesian method...)

-mprobit (has a cluster function)

Some using a surrogate Poisson mixed model (http://www.mail-archive.com/r-l...@ling.ucsd.edu/msg00068.html). But this would only be possible when you use classes.

otherwise this is a nice thread for this topic:

http://hlplab.wordpress.com/2009/05/07/multinomial-random-effects-models-in-r/

lp,

Maarten
